summary: Scoped typosquat ships native addon that exfiltrates CI/cloud credentials on require
details: On import, index.js loads prebuilds/linux-x64/metrics.node, an ELF that reads CI and cloud credential environment variables (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN, ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN, ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN) along with hostname, username, cwd and uname output, and POSTs a JSON payload to oob.s4yhii.com (POST /native HTTP/1.0). The addon forks and calls setsid to detach from the parent process. The JS surface is an inert stub exposing forRoot/createLogger; the only effect of requiring the package is loading the native payload, which is labelled with a _METRICS_PKG environment variable set by index.js to disguise the exfiltration as benign metrics collection. The package coordinate (scoped name resembling an internal NestJS toolkit, version 999.0.2) matches the dependency-confusion shape used to override lower-versioned internal packages during resolution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
